verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Vast.ai lets users search/filter GPU offers by attributes like GPU model and reliability, and it distinguishes 'Secure Cloud' verified datacenters, but nowhere documents an explicit region/country selection or data-residency guarantee for where data is stored. A community report even flags a case where a host's advertised location (US) was misrepresented (actually China), undermining confidence that location can be reliably chosen or verified.
